info.title: EmailFlare API
info.summary: Send transactional email from your own Cloudflare account.
info.description: The public HTTP API of a self-hosted EmailFlare deployment. Replace the server URL with your own Worker address. Dashboard-only endpoints under `/api/*` use browser sessions and are not part of this specification.

baseUrl.description: The workers.dev address or custom domain of your deployment.

tags.name: Send
tags.description: Send email with a scoped API key.

tags.name: Unsubscribe
tags.description: Public endpoints that unsubscribe a recipient with a one-time token.

post.description: Sends one message to one or more recipients. Each recipient gets their own message. Provide a stored template (`templateSlug` or `templateId`) or raw `html` and `text`. The status is `200` when at least one recipient succeeded, `202` for a scheduled send, and `502` when every recipient failed.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A repeat request with the same key and API key returns the first recorded result with `cached: true` instead of sending again. Use one recipient per idempotent request.

200.description: At least one recipient succeeded. Check `results` for per-recipient errors. A cached idempotent replay also returns `200`.

202.description: The message was queued for delivery at `sendAt`.

400.description: A field is missing or malformed: an invalid address, more than 50 recipients, or none of `templateSlug`, `templateId`, `html`, `text`.

502.description: Every recipient failed. The body still lists the per-recipient errors.

get.description: Opened from the unsubscribe link in an email. Consumes the single-use token, suppresses the address and returns a confirmation page.

200.description: Unsubscribed. Returns an HTML confirmation page.

404.description: The token is invalid or already used.

post.description: Mail clients post to this URL when the recipient presses unsubscribe. The token can be in the query string or a form field.

apiKey.description: A key created in the dashboard under API keys. A key is limited to the domains and scope you gave it. Keys are rate limited to 100 requests per 60 seconds.

UnsubscribeToken.name: token
UnsubscribeToken.description: The one-time token from the unsubscribe link.

Error.description: An error. Status codes: `401` missing, invalid or revoked key; `403` key not authorized for the sender domain; `404` template or token not found; `429` rate limit exceeded; `500` unexpected error.

Recipients.description: One address, or up to 50. Duplicates are removed.

SendRequest.description: Include at least one of `templateSlug`, `templateId`, `html` or `text`.

from.description: Sender address. For a non-global key, its domain must be one the key may use.

fromName.description: Display name for the From header.

subject.description: Overrides a template's subject. Set it for raw html or text sends.

html.description: HTML body. Ignored when you reference a template.

text.description: Plain-text body. Ignored when you reference a template.

templateSlug.description: Slug of a stored template. Preferred over `templateId`. Case-sensitive.

templateId.description: ID of a stored template. Use `templateSlug` where you can.

variables.description: Values for the template's placeholders. Nested objects work with dot paths. Never applied to raw html or text.

themeId.description: Colour theme for a built-in layout. Ignored for custom templates.

listId.description: Audience list ID. Adds one-click unsubscribe headers.

listUnsubscribe.description: Your own unsubscribe URL, passed through as the List-Unsubscribe header.

listUnsubscribePost.description: Adds `List-Unsubscribe-Post: List-Unsubscribe=One-Click`. Defaults to true with `listId`.

track.description: Rewrite links and add an open pixel in the HTML body.

sendAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC time. More than five seconds ahead queues the message. Live keys only, and within 12 hours.

cfId.description: Message ID from Cloudflare Email Sending.

cached.description: True when an idempotent request returned an earlier result.
